1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
9: 
10:   // Ship state
11:   const ship = {
12:     x: width / 2,
13:     y: height / 2,
14:     radius: 10,
15:     angle: 0,
16:     vx: 0,
17:     vy: 0,
18:     thrust: 0.1,
19:     turnSpeed: 0.07,
20:   };
21: 
22:   // Asteroid pool
23:   const asteroids = [];
24:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
25:   let lastSpawn = 0;
26: 
27:   // Scoring
28:   let startTime = performance.now();
29:   let score = 0;
30: 
31:   // Input handling
32:   const keys = {};
33:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.code] = true));
34:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
35: 
36:   function spawnAsteroid() {
37:     const size = Math.random() * 20 + 15; // radius
38:     // Choose edge
39:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
40:     let x, y, vx, vy;
41:     const speed = Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5;
42:     if (edge === 0) { // top
43:       x = Math.random() * width;
44:       y = -size;
45:       vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
46:       vy = speed;
47:     } else if (edge === 1) { // right
48:       x = width + size;
49:       y = Math.random() * height;
50:       vx = -speed;
51:       vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
52:     } else if (edge === 2) { // bottom
53:       x = Math.random() * width;
54:       y = height + size;
55:       vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
56:       vy = -speed;
57:     } else { // left
58:       x = -size;
59:       y = Math.random() * height;
60:       vx = speed;
61:       vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
62:     }
63:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, radius: size });
64:   }
65: 
66:   function update(dt) {
67:     // Ship controls
68:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= ship.turnSpeed;
69:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += ship.turnSpeed;
70:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) {
71:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
72:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
73:     }
74:     // Apply friction
75:     ship.vx *= 0.99;
76:     ship.vy *= 0.99;
77:     ship.x += ship.vx * dt;
78:     ship.y += ship.vy * dt;
79:     // Wrap ship around edges
80:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += width;
81:     if (ship.x > width) ship.x -= width;
82:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += height;
83:     if (ship.y > height) ship.y -= height;
84: 
85:     // Asteroids movement
86:     for (const a of asteroids) {
87:       a.x += a.vx * dt;
88:       a.y += a.vy * dt;
89:     }
90:     // Remove off‑screen asteroids
91:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
92:       const a = asteroids[i];
93:       if (a.x < -a.radius || a.x > width + a.radius || a.y < -a.radius || a.y > height + a.radius) {
94:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
95:       }
96:     }
97: 
98:     // Collision detection
99:     for (const a of asteroids) {
100:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
101:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
102:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
103:       if (dist < a.radius + ship.radius) {
104:         // Game over – stop animation
105:         cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);
106:         alert('Game over! Score: ' + Math.floor(score));
107:         return false;
108:       }
109:     }
110:     // Update score
111:     score = (performance.now() - startTime) / 1000;
112:     return true;
113:   }
114: 
115:   function draw() {
116:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
117:     // Draw ship (triangle)
118:     ctx.save();
119:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
120:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
121:     ctx.beginPath();
122:     ctx.moveTo(15, 0);
123:     ctx.lineTo(-10, -8);
124:     ctx.lineTo(-10, 8);
125:     ctx.closePath();
126:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
127:     ctx.fill();
128:     ctx.restore();
129: 
130:     // Draw asteroids
131:     ctx.fillStyle = 'gray';
132:     for (const a of asteroids) {
133:       ctx.beginPath();
134:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
135:       ctx.fill();
136:     }
137: 
138:     // Draw score
139:     ctx.fillStyle = 'lime';
140:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
141:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 20);
142:   }
143: 
144:   let lastTime = performance.now();
145:   let animationId;
146:   function loop() {
147:     const now = performance.now();
148:     const dt = (now - lastTime) / 16; // normalise to ~60fps units
149:     lastTime = now;
150:     if (now - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
151:       spawnAsteroid();
152:       lastSpawn = now;
153:     }
154:     const keepRunning = update(dt);
155:     draw();
156:     if (keepRunning) animationId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
157:   }
158:   loop();
159: })();

(End of file - total 159 lines)
